title: zinnia elegans var. coccinea
intro: Zinnia elegans var. coccinea, commonly known as the Scarlet Zinnia, is a flowering plant species belonging to the family Asteraceae. This plant is known to have several health benefits, including its potential to reduce inflammation and oxidative stress, which may contribute to the prevention of chronic diseases such as cancer and cardiovascular disease. The therapeutic actions of Zinnia elegans var. coccinea include its antimicrobial, antiviral, and antifungal properties, which can be used to treat infections and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
